question: Should OpenClaw accept Podman agent sandboxing as an official bundled plugin in this repository, or should it ship externally through ClawHub/npm unless maintainers identify a missing core API?
rationale: The plugin seam exists and the linked implementation is plausible, but accepting it changes official sandbox/security posture, plugin config, docs, dependency ownership, and potentially public SDK API surface.

options.title: Review bundled Podman backend
options.body: Treat the linked PR as the official backend candidate and require security, dependency, SDK, docs, and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: External plugin first
options.body: Ask the contributor to publish a ClawHub/npm plugin using existing sandbox SDK seams and revisit bundling after adoption or an API gap is proven.

options.title: Defer to broader backend planning
options.body: Keep this narrow request parked behind the broader execution-backend/resource-profile direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82017.

recommendation.title: Review bundled Podman backend
recommendation.body: Treat the linked PR as the official backend candidate and require security, dependency, SDK, docs, and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This account introduced the OpenShell sandbox backend and existing bundled sandbox plugin pattern that the decision would extend.
